Strictly's lighting up Saturday and Sunday nights this autumn on BBC One and BBC iPlayer
Strictly Come Dancing is back for 2026, lighting up Saturday and Sunday nights this autumn on BBC One and BBC iPlayer.
Made by BBC Studios Entertainment, Strictly Come Dancing remains as the biggest Entertainment title for viewer hours on the BBC plus the latest series attracted an average audience of 7.8m viewers (main show average on 28-Day BARB 4-Screens) with 8.6m tuning in to the Grand Final to see Karen Carney and her professional partner Carlos Gu lift the Glitterball Trophy.
When is Strictly Come Dancing back on TV and BBC iPlayer?
Strictly Come Dancing returns to iPlayer and BBC One from 6.25pm on Saturday 14 November.
Join Emma, Josh and Jojo for a big night in the ballroom as our remaining couples dance for a place in the legendary Blackpool spectacular. As ever, Shirley Ballas, Craig Revel Horwood, Motsi Mabuse and Anton Du Beke provide their thoughts and feedback on this weekâs routines before the vote opens and you have the power to completely change the leaderboard.

Who are the new Strictly Come Dancing presenters?
The new presenting line-up for Strictly Come Dancing 2026 features three hosts - for the first time ever.
Presenter Emma Willis, professional dancer Johannes Radebe and comedian Josh Widdicombe preside over the Strictly ballroom in spectacular style this autumn.
Read more: Strictly Come Dancing 2026 presenting trio Emma Willis, Johannes Radebe and Josh Widdicombe unveiled

Who left Strictly Come Dancing this week?
SPOILER ALERT! Click below to reveal the results of the dance off.
Bethany Antonia and Nancy Xu left the competition following a dance off against Cach Mercer and Maddie Ingoldsby.
Both couples performed their routines again. Bethany and Nancy performed their Foxtrot to Bleeding Love by Leona Lewis, before Cach and Maddie performed their Waltz to That Ain’t You by Mulaa Joans.
After both couples had danced, the judges delivered their verdicts:
Anton Du Beke chose to save Cach and Maddie.
Craig Revel Horwood chose to save Bethany and Nancy.
Motsi Mabuse chose to save Bethany and Nancy.
Head Judge Shirley Ballas – who this week was the judge with the deciding vote – voted to save Cach and Maddie, it meant that Bethany and Nancy would be leaving the competition.
Lawrence Robb and Jowita PrzystaÅ left the competition following Strictly’s first ever three-couple dance off against Bethany Antonia and Nancy Xu, and Jaime Winstone and Carlos Gu.
The three couples performed their routines again. Bethany and Nancy performed their Jive to I’m In Love With a Monster by Fifth Harmony, Jaime and Carlos performed their Salsa to Filthy / Gorgeous by Scissor Sisters, and Lawrence and Jowita performed their Tango to Ghostbustersby Ray Parker Jr.
After the three couples had danced, the judges delivered their verdicts on who they wished to eliminate:
Head judge Shirley Ballas chose to eliminate Lawrence and Jowita
Anton Du Beke chose to eliminate Lawrence and Jowita
Craig Revel Horwood chose to eliminate Lawrence and Jowita
Therefore with three votes, Lawrence and Jowita became the next couple to leave the competition. Motsi Mabuse – who this week was the judge with the deciding vote – said if her vote was needed, she would have chosen to eliminate Lawrence and Jowita.
Shaun Wright-Phillips and Alexis Warr left the competition following a dance off against Jaime Winstone and Carlos Gu.
Both couples performed their routines again. Jaime and Carlos performed their Foxtrot to Man I Need by Olivia Dean, before Shaun Wright-Phillips and Alexis Warr performed their Jive to Faith by Stevie Wonder ft. Ariana Grande.
After both couples had danced, the judges delivered their verdicts:
Craig Revel Horwood chose to save Jaime and Carlos
Motsi Mabuse chose to save Jaime and Carlos
Head Judge Shirley Ballas chose to save Shaun and Alexis
Anton Du Beke – who this week was the judge with the deciding vote - chose to save Jaime and Carlos
Therefore Jaime and Carlos were saved and Shaun and Alexis are the next couple to leave the competition.
Dame Sarah Storey and Julian Caillon left the competition following a dance off against Bethany Antonia and Nancy Xu.
Both couples performed their Icons Week routines again. Dame Sarah and Julian performed their Tango to That Don’t Impress Me Much by Shania Twain, before Bethany and Nancy performed their Cha Cha to Respect by Aretha Franklin.
After both couples had danced, the judges delivered their verdicts:
Anton Du Beke chose to save Bethany and Nancy.
Craig Revel Horwood chose to save Bethany and Nancy.
Motsi Mabuse chose to save Bethany and Nancy.
With three votes in favour of Bethany and Nancy, it meant Dame Sarah and Julian would be leaving the competition. Head Judge Shirley Ballas – who this week was the judge with the deciding vote – said she would have saved Bethany and Nancy if she had been required to vote.
Melanie Walters and AljaÅ¾ Škorjanec left the competition following a dance off against Shaun Wright-Phillips and Alexis Warr.
Shaun and Alexis performed their Quickstep to I’m a Believer by The Monkees, before Melanie and AljaÅ¾ performed their Charleston to Ooh Ahh... Just A Little Bit by Gina G.
After both couples had danced, the judges delivered their verdicts:
Craig Revel Horwood chose to save Shaun and Alexis.
Motsi Mabuse chose to save Melanie and AljaÅ¾.
Head Judge Shirley Ballas chose to save Shaun and Alexis.
Anton Du Beke – who was the judge with the deciding vote – saved Shaun and Alexis, meaning that Melanie and AljaÅ¾ would be leaving the competition.
In the first results show of Strictly Come Dancing 2026, Chris Appleton and Amy Dowden left the competition following a Movie Week dance off against Jaime Winstone and Carlos Gu.
Chris and Amy performed their Cha Cha to I’ll Be Ready from Baywatch, before Jaime and Carlos performed their Cha Cha to Oh, Pretty Woman from Pretty Woman.
After both couples had danced, the judges delivered their verdicts:
Motsi Mabuse chose to save Jaime and Carlos.
Head Judge Shirley Ballas chose to save Jaime and Carlos.
Anton Du Beke chose to save Jaime and Carlos.
With three votes in favour of Jaime and Carlos, they won the majority vote meaning that Chris and Amy would be leaving the competition.
Craig Revel Horwood - who was the judge with the deciding vote - said that he would also have saved Jaime and Carlos, should he have been required to vote.
This year a dynamic and world class roster of returning Professional Dancers are joined by fresh top talent from the international dance world, bringing an exciting mix of experience and showmanship to the Strictly ballroom.
Returning to the dance floor later this year are: Dianne Buswell, Julian Caillon, Amy Dowden, Katya Jones, Neil Jones, Nikita Kuzmin, Jowita PrzystaÅ, AljaÅ¾ Å korjanec, Alexis Warr, Kai Widdrington, Nancy Xu, Carlos Gu, Lauren Oakley and Vito Coppola.
In addition to the returning Pros, there will be brand new professional dancers joining the line-up in 2026.
Five new Professional Dancers are joining the hit series when it returns to light up Saturday and Sunday nights on the BBC this September.
Hailing from the UK, Canada, Italy, South Africa and Ukraine, Strictlyâs new fab five have all danced their way to international acclaim and are some of the most exciting talents in dance today.
Get to know Aleksandra, Cristian, Lethabo, Maddie and Mark: Strictly Come Dancing announces five new Pro Dancers
Strictly 2026 Theme Weeks and Instant Dance Challenge
The much-loved themed weeks - including Movies, Icons, Halloween and Musicals - are back! Here are some dates for your diary.
As well as all this, one of the most iconic milestones of the series, the annual visit to the iconic Blackpool Tower Ballroom, will once again be a highlight for everyone to look forward to. That's on 21 November.
The Instant Dance challenge will also be back, following its high-energy debut in 2025.
Back once again for the new series will be the esteemed judging panel of Craig Revel Horwood, Motsi Mabuse, Anton Du Beke and Head Judge Shirley Ballas who will be casting a watchful eye over the performances each week, giving their expert view on the dances and delivering their all-important scores.
Strictly - It Takes Two returns this September to BBC Two and BBC iPlayer with a new look and a new host: comedian, presenter, and former Strictly contestant Ellie Taylor!
Ellie's mission is to bring you more access, more insight and more Strictly magic than ever before. With new episodes premiering every weeknight from the home of Strictly, Elstree Studios, It Takes Two will offer a peek behind the curtain at everything that goes into making the UK's favourite dance show - with more to see than ever before.
Read more: Strictly It Takes Two's Ellie Taylor on her new role, the new series and that Casualty tango - "Itâs a dream come true"
The biggest range of Strictly Come Dancing programming on BBC iPlayer ever is led by new show Strictly: Lights Up, and further fab new exclusives and features for this year's hotly-anticipated series.
Hosted by comedian Abi Clarke and presenter and Strictly alum Tyler West, Strictly: Lights Up will be available exclusively on BBC iPlayer every Sunday night immediately after the results show has finished. Abi and Tyler will take viewers straight on to the Strictly dance floor for immediate reactions from the night's eliminated couple, their dance off opponents - plus the judges, hosts, other Strictly stars and studio guests.
BBC iPlayer will also launch a new dedicated Strictly hub, featuring all things Strictly including a range of new exclusives.
Alongside Strictly: Lights Up there'll be new weekly training room episodes, where Abi visits different Strictly couples in rehearsals; plus a new weekly highlights show to round-up the week of Strictly Come Dancing. Every single dance of the series will also be available to watch individually whenever you want and, for the first time ever, each episode of Strictly Come Dancing will have the option to scroll through in chapters - letting viewers easily jump between their favourite couples and revisit unmissable Strictly moments.

स्ट्रिक्टली कम डांसिंग बीबीसी वन और बीबीसी आईप्लेयर पर अपने 2026 सीजन के साथ वापसी कर रहा है, जिसमें नए सेलिब्रिटी प्रतियोगी, पेशेवर नर्तक और प्रस्तुतकर्ता शामिल हैं।

### प्रस्तुतकर्ता और जज
* **प्रस्तुतकर्ता तिकड़ी:** एम्मा विलिस, जोहान्स राडेबे और जोश विडिबॉम्ब शो की मेजबानी कर रहे हैं।
* **जज पैनल:** शर्ली बैलास, क्रेग रेवेल हॉरवुड, मोटसी माबुस और एंटोन डू बेके अपने फैसले और स्कोर देने के लिए लौट रहे हैं।

### सेलिब्रिटी प्रतियोगी
* डेनी डायर, डेल्टा गुड्रेम, क्रिस एप्पलटन, कैश मर्सर, डेम सारा स्टोरे और मेलानी वाल्टर्स इस सीजन के कलाकारों में शामिल हैं।

### अन्य कार्यक्रम
* *इट टेक्स टू* बीबीसी टू और आईप्लेयर पर एली टेलर की मेजबानी में प्रसारित होगा।
* नई आईप्लेयर सीरीज *स्ट्रिक्टली: लाइट्स अप* की मेजबानी अभी क्लार्क और टायलर वेस्ट करेंगे।
* इस सीरीज में थीम वीक और ब्लैकपूल टॉवर बॉलरूम का दौरा भी शामिल है।
